# Kummer extension generated by the p-th roots of the S-units

Let $p$ be a prime and $K$ a number field containing a primitive $p$-th root of unity. Let $S$ be a finite
set of places of $K$ containing the infinite places and the places above $p$, let $s = |S|$, and let
$U(S) = \{ a \in K^\times : \mathrm{ord}_{\mathfrak{p}}(a) = 0 \text{ for every finite place } \mathfrak{p} \notin S \}$
be the group of $S$-units. Let $M = K[U(S)^{1/p}]$ be the field obtained by adjoining to $K$ the $p$-th
roots of all $S$-units, in a fixed algebraic closure. Then:

1. $U(S) \cap K^{\times p} = U(S)^p$, and $U(S) / U(S)^p$ is an elementary abelian group of order $p^s$;
2. $M/K$ is a finite abelian extension whose Galois group is killed by $p$, and $[M : K] = p^s$;
3. every finite place of $K$ outside $S$ is unramified in $M$.

Part 1: if $a^p \in U(S)$ with $a \in K^\times$, then $a \in U(S)$; and by
[Dirichlet's S-unit theorem](../../discriminants-ramification/s-unit-theorem.md),
$U(S) \cong \mu(K) \times \mathbb{Z}^{s-1}$ with $\mu(K)$ cyclic of order divisible by $p$. Part 2 follows
from [Kummer theory](../../../../FieldTheory/galois-theory/kummer-theory.md) for the group
$B = U(S) K^{\times p}$, which gives $[M : K] = (B : K^{\times p}) = (U(S) : U(S) \cap K^{\times p})$.
Part 3: for $a \in U(S)$ and a finite place $v \notin S$, both $p$ and $a$ are units at $v$, so $v$ does
not divide the discriminant $\pm p^p a^{p-1}$ of $X^p - a$ and is unramified in $K[a^{1/p}]$; a compositum
of extensions unramified at $v$ is unramified at $v$.

- [Places of a number field](../places-of-a-number-field/place.md)

## Proof depends on

- [Dirichlet's S-unit theorem](../../discriminants-ramification/s-unit-theorem.md)
- [Kummer theory for abelian extensions of exponent dividing n](../../../../FieldTheory/galois-theory/kummer-theory.md), for $n = p$

## Sources

- J. S. Milne, *Class Field Theory*, version 4.03 (2020),
  <https://www.jmilne.org/math/CourseNotes/CFT.pdf>: Section VII.6, the paragraph before Lemma 6.2
  (the extension $M = K[U(S)^{1/p}]$, with $U(S)/U(S)^p \approx (\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})^s$), and the
  proof of Lemma VII.9.3 (the same extension: $U(S) \cap K^{\times p} = U(S)^p$ and
  $(U(S) : U(S)^p) = p^s$); Appendix to Chapter VII, Theorem A.3 (Kummer theory) and Proposition A.5
  ($K[a_1^{1/n}, \dots, a_m^{1/n}]$ is unramified at a finite prime $v$ at which $n$ and every $a_i$ are
  units, by the discriminant $\pm n^n a^{n-1}$ of $X^n - a$; Milne's statement says "$n a_i$ is a unit",
  which does not suffice, as $K = \mathbb{Q}$, $n = 2$, $a = 1/2$, $v = 2$ shows; the discriminant argument
  needs $n$ and $a_i$ to be units separately).
